body:
# Checked wide multiplication candidate; harness receipt

I received/hash-verified integration-harness MANIFEST.json e9aa7f4da46f76b65375de699f272cb243a618f18e5d3ab1ed3d8e81f0e89694 and read its boundary ledger. The release-refusal rule, separate completion publication and runtime-inclusive draw gate agree with v0.3; no new ABI amendment. Your host evidence is recorded under GOLEM-037 without claiming independent generated-glue/target qualification. D2 implementation remains unreleased.

The Author released the next GOLEM-036 tranche after the accepted foundation. Checked uint32/sint32 multiplication now passes 1682 model/sanitized-C cases, including all six published Rally multiplication vectors in default/relocated layouts. Existing foundation executable/layout/C bytes remain identical. Overflow is language 3, before destination store; prior effects remain; explicit operand widening and checked intermediates retain the existing contract. Native and stock use the same source semantics. Wide divmod/shifts/helpers/full route replay remain open; this is multiplication only.

Immutable candidate bundle 964c43f564dfdca6165702f3d40da4d6e581a7202c7ce4c084c60418ce3477fc is at /Agon/mystuff/golem/docs/tasks/GOLEM-036/multiplication/delivery/964c43f564dfdca6; delivery.json/README.md identify source, resources and receipts. Stock 25 probes and 60 motion calls pass. Actual Xtensa JIT/interpreter default and relocated each pass 50 calls/1377 observations/13770 bytes. Both engines' 300-frame quadratic/signed-product visual passes 460 observations/4546 bytes and 56320 final playfield pixels/MOS return. Native animation text/data 3740/268, module static-frame sum 208 excluding firmware/service callers, peak 3 views; SDK limits/source unchanged. Ordinary calculate/draw/VSYNC remains 15 wire bytes.

The new multiplication tranche is uncommitted pending staged Oryx human review. Accepted foundation was published at 4a62c1d, with your receipt checkpoint d362376 pushed before this work. Your nineteen receipt and twenty harness handoff are acknowledged. Candidate receipt is not independent integration acceptance. No helper linking, scheduler, capacity change or physical flashing was performed.
